metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: Since they loved Finding Nemo, they will enjoy this underwater adventure following Dory's heartwarming journey to find her parents.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An action-packed and beautifully animated adventure about friendship and dragons, perfect for fans of Kung Fu Panda and Puss in Boots.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the sequel, they must see the imaginative and emotional original film that started it all.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious DreamWorks comedy about a supervillain who accidentally defeats his nemesis, perfect for fans of Despicable Me and Shrek.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A thrilling and humorous Pixar movie about a family of superheroes, matching the high-energy action of Sonic and Spider-Man.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A charming and sunny coming-of-age fantasy set in Italy, sharing the beautiful aesthetic and gentle vibe of Ponyo.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A video-game-themed adventure filled with fun cameos, perfect for kids who loved The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: Based on the same story as The Borrowers, this beautiful Studio Ghibli film offers a magical take on the tiny people living hidden lives.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they've seen Frozen II, they will love revisiting the iconic songs and snowy magic of the original sisterhood adventure.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A wonderfully chaotic and hilarious family road trip interrupted by a robot apocalypse, ideal for fans of Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A heartwarming, beautifully crafted live-action family comedy that is universally loved for its humor and kindness.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Completes the trilogy they started, offering more incredible martial arts action, hilarious comedy, and sweet family moments.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: A highly creative, fast-paced comedy adventure that appeals perfectly to fans of Sonic and The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: This fun prequel to Monsters, Inc. shows how Mike and Sulley overcame their differences in college to become best friends.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Offers more of the hilarious Minion antics and heartwarming family dynamics they loved in the original Despicable Me.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: An incredibly funny, fast-paced animal adventure that answers what pets do when their owners leave for the day.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A magnificent adventure about an elderly man, a young Wilderness Explorer, and a talking dog flying to South America in a balloon house.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest and most quotable comedies, matching the fast-paced, irreverent humor of Shrek.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A heartwarming and humorous tale of a lonely Hawaiian girl who adopts an unruly alien experiment, perfect for fans of Turning Red.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical, family-friendly Studio Ghibli fantasy about a girl who is whisked away to the Cat Kingdom.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A touching, magical adventure about a group of kids helping a cute Yeti return home to Mount Everest.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A dialogue-free comedic masterpiece from the creators of Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit, packed with clever slapstick.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A prehistoric road trip adventure full of imaginative creatures, family comedy, and heart, perfect for fans of Migration.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical modern-day fantasy adventure about two elf brothers on a quest, matching the heart and humor of Inside Out.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed, heartwarming superhero adventure featuring the lovable inflatable robot Baymax.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A witty and heartwarming animated musical comedy about a school class lizard who dispenses wisdom to elementary students.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A delightfully absurd and colorful comedy about an inventor whose machine makes food fall from the sky.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A stunningly animated Pixar film exploring friendship and family expectations in a city where elements live together.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A cute and action-filled road trip story about a TV star dog who believes he actually has superpowers.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A charming and sweet live-action/CGI hybrid movie about a polite bear from Peru adjusting to life in London.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: The highly-anticipated sequel to Chicken Run, offering the same level of witty British humor and thrilling claymation escapes.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A hilarious adventure about zoo animals who find themselves stranded in the wild, perfect for fans of Rio and Zootopia.

metas.name: Ice Age
metas.description: A classic pre-historic buddy comedy featuring a mammoth, a sloth, and a saber-toothed tiger on a mission to return a human baby.

metas.name: Peter Pan
metas.description: A classic Disney fantasy that matches the vintage magical charm of Alice in Wonderland.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A vibrant animated musical adventure about a young girl who builds a rocket ship to meet a mythical moon goddess.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A hilarious spin-off focusing entirely on the chaotic yellow henchmen, providing non-stop physical comedy for kids.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical Disney musical that pays homage to classic fairy tales, perfect for kids who loved Tangled and Moana.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A heartwarming Pixar classic about a hotshot race car who learns the value of friendship and community in a small town.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A sweet, creative, and family-friendly adventure where an anxious boy meets the physical embodiment of his greatest fear: the Dark.
